snippet.title: CraftFighter Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
CraftFighter is a fighting game made with CraftStudio. It is set in the Minecraft universe. We developed a multiplayer beta version of CraftFighter over the course of 2 weeks for Minecon 2012.
The game is best played with Xbox 360 controllers but can be played with a keyboard too.

Website: http://www.cubixgames.com/craftfighter/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/CubixGames
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/Cubixgames

CraftStudio is a cooperative game-making platform which lets people build 2D and 3D games from scratch in real-time over the Internet.

More information on http://www.craftstud.io/
